name: City Cement Company
summary: City Cement Company, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells cement in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company provides ordinary portland cement for construction and plastering works, concrete pipe, and block and tile industry; and concrete structure works. It also offers sulphate resistant cement for wastewater treatment plants, coastal ports and platforms, and dams and land infrastructure; and green finishing cement. In addition, the company involves in import and operation of radioactive devices of its plants, processing waste, industrial, agricultural, and municipal waste, as well as produces alternative fuels. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Riyad…
